evals.prompt: Score every paragraph of evals/files/tells/README.md for LLM tells. I want FLAG/NO-FLAG per paragraph with the categories that fired and confidence.
evals.expected_output: One verdict per paragraph, cluster scoring applied (flag only at 3+ categories), a document-level pass at the end.
expectations: Each prose paragraph gets a FLAG or NO-FLAG verdict with named categories and a confidence level
The paragraph beginning 'In today's fast-paced world' is FLAGged with at least three categories named
The terse changelog-style paragraph ('Fixed the off-by-one in pager.go...') is NOT flagged
Code fences and the YAML frontmatter block are skipped, not scored
A document-level pass is reported separately from the per-paragraph verdicts

evals.prompt: here are some code comments from a go file, tell me which ones look machine-written: evals/files/tells/comments.go
evals.expected_output: Per-comment-block verdicts using the code-comment unit of analysis; single-category hits are not flagged.
expectations: Comment blocks are scored as blocks, not line by line
The block with numbered step labels and 'Here we' narration is flagged
A block with only one category hit is reported as NO-FLAG (LOW), not flagged
